title: Malmgren helped Shoichiro Toyoda set up Toyota's headquarters in Kentucky
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Malmgren helped Shoichiro Toyoda set up Toyota's headquarters in Kentucky, about 1980s at Kentucky, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We talked about Harold helping Shiro Toyota set up the Toyota headquarters in Kentucky.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels recalls what Harold Malmgren, described as a former presidential advisor, told him about his career. According to Michels, Malmgren said he helped Shoichiro Toyoda, of the Toyota car company, set up Toyota's headquarters in Kentucky in the 1980s. It is told to show how well connected Malmgren was.
